readme_snippet:
Claude Code Game Studios

Turn a single Claude Code session into a full game development studio.
49 agents. 74 skills. One coordinated AI team.

# T3 Code

T3 Code is an "agent harness control surface". It enables control of the agents on your machine with a best-in-class mobile app ([iOS](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/t3-code-remote-claude-more/id6787819824), [Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.t3tools.t3code)), [web app](https://app.t3.codes) and [Electron-based desktop app](https://t3.codes).

Works with your subscriptions on Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok Build, OpenCode, Google Antigravity, and fx. If they're set up on your computer, T3 Code can control them.

description: The design vocabulary for your coding agent. Steer with polish and bolder, review with critique and audit, catch AI slop before it ships.
readme_snippet:
# Impeccable

The design vocabulary for your coding agent. Steer with `polish` and `bolder`, review with `critique` and `audit`, and catch AI slop before it ships.

From your project root:

```bash
npx impeccable install
```

Reload your coding tool, then run `/impeccable init` in your agent (`$impeccable init` on Codex).

Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, GitHub Copilot, Devin, Replit Agent, Gemini CLI, Grok Build, OpenCode, Google Antigravity, Kiro, Trae, Rovo Dev, Qoder, Mistral Vibe, Pi, Hermes Agent, DeepSeek Harness, and Veto. Full docs live at [impeccable.style/docs](https://impeccable.style/docs).

readme_snippet:
# Orkas

**An open-source team of AI agents on your desktop — it turns your goals into finished work and keeps it moving.**

Orkas is an open-source (MIT), local-first multi-agent desktop app — an AI assistant that works as a team. Tell the **Commander** what you need: it finishes many tasks on its own, and for bigger work it plans the steps and brings in specialist agents along with the coding and personal agents you already use — **Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw and Hermes-Agent** — to work on it together.
